headlines.name: Math115.ShapeDegreeBound.available_bound_le
headlines.statement:
∀ (m n R C : ℕ),
  2 ≤ m →
    2 ≤ n →
      R ≤ m →
        C ≤ n →
          2 ≤ m * n - R * C →
            ∀ (s t : Math115.ShapeDegreeBound.CellType),
              Math115.ShapeDegreeBound.available m n R C s t →
                Math115.ShapeDegreeBound.bound m n R C s t ≤ 4 * (m * n - R * C) - 3

headlines.name: Math115.ShapeDegreeBound.degreeEnvelope_le
headlines.statement:
∀ (m n R C : ℕ),
  2 ≤ m →
    2 ≤ n →
      R ≤ m → C ≤ n → 2 ≤ m * n - R * C → Math115.ShapeDegreeBound.degreeEnvelope m n R C ≤ 4 * (m * n - R * C) - 3

headlines.name: Math115.ShapeScalarScales.proposal_rational_coefficient_le
headlines.statement:
∀ (m n R C V : ℕ),
  2 ≤ m →
    2 ≤ n →
      R ≤ m →
        C ≤ n →
          2 ≤ m * n - R * C →
            2 ≤ V →
              4 * ↑(Math115.ShapeDegreeBound.proposalAllowance m n R C) *
                  Math115.PhysicalRepairRefinement.refinedConstant (m * n - R * C) V ≤
                16 * ↑(m * n - R * C) ^ 4 * ↑V ^ 4

headlines.name: Math115.ShapeScalarScales.proposal_dyadic_coefficient_le
headlines.statement:
∀ (m n R C V : ℕ),
  2 ≤ m →
    2 ≤ n →
      R ≤ m →
        C ≤ n →
          2 ≤ m * n - R * C →
            2 ≤ V →
              2 * ↑(Math115.ShapeScalarScales.dyadicDenominator (Math115.ShapeDegreeBound.proposalAllowance m n R C)) *
                  Math115.PhysicalRepairRefinement.refinedConstant (m * n - R * C) V ≤
                32 * ↑(m * n - R * C) ^ 4 * ↑V ^ 4

headlines.name: Math115.ShapeScalarScales.guarded_padded_count_le_twice
headlines.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : DecidableEq I]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq J] (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) (K : Finset (I × J)) (L : ℕ),
  (∀ p ∈ K, Math115.ShapeScalarScales.guardedCutoff K.card L ((Fintype.card I - 1) * (Fintype.card J - 1)) ≤ r p.1) →
    (∀ p ∈ K, Math115.ShapeScalarScales.guardedCutoff K.card L ((Fintype.card I - 1) * (Fintype.card J - 1)) ≤ c p.2) →
      Fintype.card
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.Table (OAI.ContingencyTables.paddedRows r (OAI.ContingencyTables.largePadding K L))
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.paddedColumns c (OAI.ContingencyTables.largePadding K L))) ≤
        2 * Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c)

headlines.name: Math115.ShapeScalarScales.localDimension_conditions
headlines.statement:
∀ (R C : ℕ),
  14 ≤ Math115.ShapeScalarScales.localDimension R C ∧
    R ≤ Math115.ShapeScalarScales.localDimension R C ∧
      C ≤ Math115.ShapeScalarScales.localDimension R C ∧
        (R - 1) * (C - 1) ≤ Math115.ShapeScalarScales.localDimension R C - 1

headlines.name: Research.AcceptancePadding.reference_edge_acceptance_block_floor
headlines.statement:
∀ {I J : Type u} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : LinearOrder I] [inst_3 : LinearOrder J] (r : I → ℕ)
  (c : J → ℕ) (U L : ℕ) (B : I → J → ℕ)
  (hB : ∀ (i : I) (j : J), OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U i j = true → B i j = U)
  (i₀ : OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeRows r U)
  (j₀ : OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeColumns c U),
  3 * (Fintype.card { i // i ≠ i₀ } * Fintype.card { j // j ≠ j₀ }) ≤
      min (Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeRows r U))
          (Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeColumns c U)) *
        L →
    (∀
        (z :
          OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.PhysicalStates
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) B r c L)
        (i : I) (j : J),
        OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U i j = false →
          ∑ k,
              OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.residualRows
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) B r c L z k ≤
            B i j) →
      ∀
        (x y :
          OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.PhysicalStates
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) B r c L),
        OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.physicalAdjacent r c U L B hB x y →
          ↑(OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionTranslation.blockCount
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceRows r c U L B i₀)
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceColumns r c U L B j₀) x) /
              2 ≤
            ↑(OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionTranslation.acceptedCount
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceRows r c U L B i₀)
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceColumns r c U L B j₀) x y)

headlines.name: Research.AcceptancePadding.reference_edge_acceptance_floorPadding
headlines.statement:
∀ {I J : Type u} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : LinearOrder I] [inst_3 : LinearOrder J] (r : I → ℕ)
  (c : J → ℕ) (U : ℕ) (B : I → J → ℕ)
  (hB : ∀ (i : I) (j : J), OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U i j = true → B i j = U)
  (i₀ : OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeRows r U)
  (j₀ : OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeColumns c U),
  (∀
      (z :
        OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.PhysicalStates
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) B r c
          (Research.AcceptancePadding.floorPadding
            (Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeRows r U))
            (Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeColumns c U))))
      (i : I) (j : J),
      OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U i j = false →
        ∑ k,
            OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.residualRows
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) B r c
              (Research.AcceptancePadding.floorPadding
                (Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeRows r U))
                (Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeColumns c U)))
              z k ≤
          B i j) →
    ∀
      (x y :
        OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.PhysicalStates
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) B r c
          (Research.AcceptancePadding.floorPadding
            (Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeRows r U))
            (Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeColumns c U)))),
      OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.physicalAdjacent r c U
          (Research.AcceptancePadding.floorPadding
            (Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeRows r U))
            (Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeColumns c U)))
          B hB x y →
        ↑(OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionTranslation.blockCount
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceRows r c U
                  (Research.AcceptancePadding.floorPadding
                    (Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeRows r U))
                    (Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeColumns c U)))
                  B i₀)
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceColumns r c U
                  (Research.AcceptancePadding.floorPadding
                    (Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeRows r U))
                    (Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeColumns c U)))
                  B j₀)
                x) /
            2 ≤
          ↑(OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionTranslation.acceptedCount
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceRows r c U
                (Research.AcceptancePadding.floorPadding
                  (Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeRows r U))
                  (Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeColumns c U)))
                B i₀)
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceColumns r c U
                (Research.AcceptancePadding.floorPadding
                  (Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeRows r U))
                  (Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeColumns c U)))
                B j₀)
              x y)

headlines.name: Research.AcceptancePadding.floorPadding_budget
headlines.statement: ∀ (R C : ℕ), 0 < R → 0 < C → 3 * ((R - 1) * (C - 1)) ≤ min R C * Research.AcceptancePadding.floorPadding R C

headlines.name: Research.AcceptancePadding.cutoff_budget
headlines.statement:
∀ (m n R C : ℕ),
  47 * (R * C) * Research.AcceptancePadding.floorPadding R C * ((m - 1) * (n - 1)) ≤
    32 * (Research.AcceptancePadding.cutoff m n R C + 1)

headlines.name: Research.AcceptancePadding.outerCutoff_budget
headlines.statement:
∀ (m n R C d : ℕ),
  2 ≤ d →
    0 < R →
      0 < C →
        R ≤ m →
          C ≤ n →
            m * n ≤ d →
              47 * (R * C) * Research.AcceptancePadding.floorPadding R C * ((m - 1) * (n - 1)) ≤
                32 * (Research.AcceptancePadding.outerCutoff m n d + 1)
